items.summary: improve(memory): reindex only changed chunks of an edited memory file (#175608) Memory files always took complete replacement: every chunk row was deleted and reinserted, and the FTS entries were rebuilt, even when an edit touched one chunk. Lift the six sessions-only gates so the existing delta planner and publication path also serve memory files. When no prepared chunk matches a stored row, keep complete replacement, which scans vectors once instead of issuing scalar deletes per row. Unchanged chunks keep their rows and only refresh recall metadata and provenance. The builtin memory docs now describe both sources. Co-authored-by: Mitchell Etzel
